label: Maxime-ens route operation-naming leaves: universal cause is maximal; naming from operation
summary: Baseline df4909cb0. Both leaves are premises only of 61ac44a6 (result 7280ac5f), one of three support bundles for the beec1dc1 premise e39a4fce; the others, 2dc44ef4 and e28fb989, come from the fuller naming 1ec205ed. On beec1dc1, e39a4fce is used only inside maximeEnsIsGod, and its GOD_2 output is consumed only with 777646a5 to identify first movers with the maximum. GOD_4 comes only from a594d8c4, so GOD_2 never passes into GOD_4. 57b88730 is derivable from route premises a9622441, 6c27657f, 101bdd62, d5a94eb1 (at esse only) and ee4ab504: a maximum z exists by the quarta via steps, and if z differs from a universal cause m, then m causes z's being, so m is more a being than z, which contradicts z's maximality. This was checked in a zero-axiom scratch Lean replica with the definitions copied verbatim; it is not registered. The direct supports of the five premises do not use the naming leaves. It is not a meaning postulate: the one-being interpretation in which no being has being satisfies d5a94eb1 and excluded middle but falsifies it (scratch needsSomeMaximum; that control uses Classical.em and so is not zero-axiom). 709ad5d2 is consumed at GOD_2, but its record carries the GOD_1 tag (18945900). truth semantics 61ac44a6 reports legacy allowlisted GOD_1/GOD_2 mixing, so the GOD_1 tag is a labelling defect. At GOD_1 (NominalGod) the statement would also require remoteness and the causation of every perfection, which nothing supplies. Under route premises, 709ad5d2 and e39a4fce are interderivable: 7280ac5f gives one direction, and the converse with d9fad785 at esse was scratch-checked (operationNamingFromReduced). The from-operation bundle therefore adds no warrant beyond what is already recorded for e39a4fce: its source warrant (q.13 a.8 co.; 9b52e1a5) is already linked to e39a4fce (relations 57a2a495, 79a42a61), so counting it separately would double-count. The materialized AQUINAS-ST-I-Q13-A8 passage (423cc2f7) was read in full. It imposes the name from universal providence (id a quo) to signify the divine nature, with the ratio supra omnia existens, principium omnium, remotum ab omnibus. The leaf substitutes causing being for providence, drops supra omnia and remotum, and turns the id a quo into a sufficient condition of application (q.13 a.8's stone example shows it is not sufficient in general; universality plus uniqueness close that gap), as an analyst inference supported but not stated by 9b52e1a5 (relation 7cc5ccee). Also instantiating God by the reduced description makes e39a4fce trivially true (scratch). The naming content then moves into reading 777646a5's q.105 a.5 claim at the named bearer.

current_assessment.assessment: 57b88730: derivable, from five premises beec1dc1 already uses: a9622441, 6c27657f, 101bdd62, d5a94eb1 (at esse only) and ee4ab504. The derivation is scratch-checked and unregistered, and its warrant is theirs. It is not a meaning postulate, because without an existing maximum it fails in a one-being interpretation. No substantive objection to the inference was identified. 709ad5d2: a defended direct option. It is a reference-fixing nominal stipulation at GOD_2 and is not independent of e39a4fce: under route premises the two are interderivable (7280ac5f, and the scratch converse with d9fad785 at esse), so 61ac44a6 adds no warrant beyond what is already recorded for e39a4fce. Its source warrant (q.13 a.8 co.; 9b52e1a5) is already linked to e39a4fce (relations 57a2a495, 79a42a61), so counting 61ac44a6 separately would double-count the same evidence. Its warrant is q.13 a.8 co. (the name is imposed from an operation) and the quarta via's 'et hoc dicimus Deum' (9b52e1a5, relation 7cc5ccee), as support rather than statement, plus three analyst steps. The leaf puts causing being for providence. It drops supra omnia and remotum. It turns the id a quo into a sufficient condition of application, which q.13 a.8 distinguishes from what the name signifies (the stone example), and relies on universality plus uniqueness to close that gap. The dropped-remotum objection (world-form rival, q.13 a.8 ad 2, q.3 a.8 claim aquinas-st-i-q3-a8-no-component-first-in-being) is answered conditionally, not refuted, by eaa4c679 and 09c6d5f0 with 57b88730, in the component-remoteness sense of 1ec205ed. These are the inputs the sibling bundles already carry. The only objection to its truth at GOD_2 that meets the standard is the dropped-remotum objection, answered conditionally. The GOD_1 tag is a record defect, and the defense does not extend to GOD_1 (NominalGod). Route: on beec1dc1 the Lean proof makes no passage from GOD_2 to GOD_4 (hGod feeds only AtMostOneFirstUnmovedMover), and the naming leaves are not its binding constraint. Reading 777646a5 at the named bearer needs its CausesIn to be CAUSE_2; the record tags it CAUSE_1 (legacy allowlisted mixing), which is an open sense gap. 777646a5 is source-stated (q.105 a.5). Its derivation support through f03798ba and d791628f needs only the some-respect content (sense (i)), not the C* relevance bridge 7bf380c6 (#1775, refining #1768). #1775 also reports that f03798ba fails under adopted POTENCY_1 for steady exercise. So on the current record c1b68c21 alone carries C* on this route. The route's support is bounded by c1b68c21 (absolute), which carries C*, and by 777646a5's POTENCY_1 gap (#1775) and a594d8c4. Per accepted-but-unmerged #1768 and #1775, C* is weak, so the route is weakly supported overall on the current record. If C* is upgraded it would be moderate, bounded by a594d8c4 and by 777646a5's POTENCY_1 steady-exercise gap. Nothing is established, defeated or closed.
